en.logline: At 11:59 PM an unknown number tells Noah not to open his door. He has spent the last hour pretending he cannot hear the rain.
en.hook: He had one instruction: don't open the door.
beats: Rain, a locked apartment, a phone face-down on the table.
An unknown number. One line of text.
The clock refuses to move past 11:59.
en.cta: Part 1 of The Last Message. Start from the beginning.

id.logline: Pukul 23.59, nomor tak dikenal mengirim satu pesan ke Noah: jangan buka pintu. Padahal di luar, hujan tidak berhenti sejak satu jam lalu.
id.hook: Cuma satu pesan: jangan buka pintu.
beats: Hujan, apartemen terkunci, ponsel tertelungkup di meja.
Nomor tak dikenal. Satu baris pesan.
Jam dinding berhenti di 23.59.
id.cta: Part 1 dari The Last Message. Mulai dari awal.

en.logline: A second message arrives with a link to a live hallway camera. The man standing outside Noah's door is wearing his face.
en.hook: Someone is standing outside his door. It is him.
beats: A link marked LIVE HALLWAY CAMERA.
An empty corridor, then a figure walks into frame.
Same hair. Same coat. Same scar.
en.cta: Part 2 of The Last Message. Watch Part 1 first.

id.logline: Pesan kedua datang dengan tautan kamera koridor. Pria yang berdiri di depan pintu Noah memakai wajahnya sendiri.
id.hook: Ada orang di depan pintunya. Itu dia.
beats: Tautan bertuliskan LIVE HALLWAY CAMERA.
Koridor kosong, lalu sesosok bayangan masuk frame.
Rambut sama. Mantel sama. Bekas luka sama.
id.cta: Part 2 dari The Last Message. Tonton Part 1 dulu.

en.logline: Noah rewinds the hallway recording. It reaches midnight while his own phone is still stuck at 11:59, and the Noah on tape walks out of the apartment.
en.hook: Two clocks. The same minute. Only one of them is his.
beats: The footage runs backwards.
Timecode rolls from 11:59 to 12:00.
The recorded Noah steps into the hall.

id.logline: Noah memutar ulang rekaman koridor. Rekaman itu sampai tengah malam, sementara ponselnya sendiri masih 23.59. Dan Noah di dalam rekaman melangkah keluar.
id.hook: Dua jam. Satu menit yang sama. Cuma satu yang miliknya.
beats: Rekaman berjalan mundur.
Timecode bergeser dari 23.59 ke 00.00.
Noah versi rekaman keluar ke koridor.

en.logline: One hundred and forty-seven messages arrive at once. The minute never changes. And whatever is texting him already knows he has done this before.
en.hook: 147 messages. One warning. No time left.
beats: One minute on the clock, and it never ticks over.
Every light in the apartment dies.
147 messages, all saying the same thing.
en.cta: Part 4 of The Last Message. The loop is closing.

id.logline: Seratus empat puluh tujuh pesan masuk sekaligus. Menitnya tidak pernah berganti. Dan pengirim pesan itu sudah tahu Noah pernah melakukan ini.
beats: Satu menit di layar, dan tidak pernah berganti.
Semua lampu di apartemen mati.
147 pesan, semuanya kalimat yang sama.
id.cta: Part 4 dari The Last Message. Loop-nya menutup.

en.logline: Noah wakes in a room he has never seen, in front of a woman who already knows his file. The record says SUBJECT 001 is terminated. He is still breathing.
en.hook: The file says SUBJECT 001: TERMINATED. Noah is still breathing.
beats: A room with a wall of monitors and no windows.
A woman who answers without turning around.
A file with his face on it, and a status that should be final.
en.quote: Find the room where you were born.
en.cta: Part 5 of The Last Message. Four parts before this one.

id.logline: Noah terbangun di ruangan yang belum pernah ia lihat, di depan seorang perempuan yang sudah tahu isi berkasnya. Catatan itu menyebut SUBJECT 001 telah dihentikan. Noah masih bernapas.
id.hook: Berkasnya bilang SUBJECT 001: TERMINATED. Noah masih bernapas.
beats: Ruangan tanpa jendela, dinding penuh monitor.
Seorang perempuan yang menjawab tanpa berbalik badan.
Sebuah berkas dengan wajahnya, dan status yang seharusnya sudah final.
id.quote: Find the room where you were born.
id.cta: Part 5 dari The Last Message. Empat part sebelumnya wajib ditonton.

en.logline: Noah opens his own apartment door and finds the laboratory that has been recording him. Every screen shows a different death, every clock is stuck at 11:59, and the only person still answering him is a woman who will not turn around.
en.hook: Every screen is him. Every clock says 11:59.
beats: A door that opens onto a laboratory instead of a hallway.
Wall after wall of Noah, each one dying at the same minute.
Midnight finally arrives, and Amara's phone says DON'T TRUST NOAH.
en.cta: Part 6 of The Last Message. The finale.

id.logline: Noah membuka pintu apartemennya sendiri dan menemukan laboratorium yang selama ini merekamnya. Setiap layar menampilkan kematian yang berbeda, setiap jam berhenti di 23.59, dan satu-satunya orang yang masih menjawabnya adalah perempuan yang tak pernah berbalik badan.
id.hook: Semua layar adalah dia. Semua jam menunjukkan 23.59.
beats: Pintu yang terbuka ke laboratorium, bukan ke koridor.
Dinding demi dinding berisi Noah, semuanya mati di menit yang sama.
Tengah malam akhirnya tiba, dan ponsel Amara berbunyi DON'T TRUST NOAH.
id.cta: Part 6 dari The Last Message. Penutup.
